g.text: Higher curves mean more puzzles solved within an expansion threshold. Failures stay in the denominator.
Confidence-aware (50) and risk-averse use RTX 3050 records. Other historical runs differ in device/budget; not a controlled runtime comparison.
These are descriptive expansion profiles of recorded runs, not independent reruns at every threshold.
